documents.note: Machine dump (pdftotext) of pages 5-7 only.  cout_bank.py uses it as the independent 100 kHz cross-check row.  The full 15-page PDF is archived as series_datasheet_full below.

Full series datasheet.  Page 3 is the only place the series states an ESR limit: endurance and 105 C/0 V storage allow ESR <= 2.0 x initial after 2,000 h.  Page 4 plots ESR vs frequency only for A720V477M002 (2 V) and A720V226M035 (35 V), with no tabulated values; the 2.5 V 470 uF part is not plotted and there is no ESR-vs-temperature or ESR-vs-bias curve.  Page 7 Table 2 publishes recommended land dimensions for case V at three density levels.

limitations: The part spec sheet is a generated parametric sheet, not the series datasheet; the series datasheet text is a hand transcription of the archived PDF, and the PDF itself is now archived in full.
The series datasheet copy is the Japanese edition hosted by a distributor mirror; the KEMET document number and revision are visible on every page.

No vendor land-pattern approval is claimed: F=2.4 mm and S=1.3 mm are body/lead dimensions, not a released footprint.  The series does publish a recommended land table (Table 2, page 7), but it is not yet mapped to a released EDA footprint.

ESR at 200 kHz, at DC bias and at operating temperature is published only as a plot for other voltage ratings, so those values remain UNKNOWN; the 105 C/2,000 h endurance limit (<= 2.0 x initial ESR) is a limit, not a curve.
